description: Make the Canvas View work like Obsidian's canvas: infinite canvas with improved node types, proper edge connection system with visible port handles, node resizing from any edge/corner, node content rendering improvements, and overall polish to match Obsidian's canvas UX
steps: In src/components/canvas/CanvasView.tsx: Improve the edge connection system. Make the connection port handles always visible when hovering a node (not just when selected). Show 4 circular port indicators (top/bottom/left/right edges) that pulse or highlight on hover to indicate they are draggable. When drawing an edge, highlight valid drop targets (other nodes' ports) so the user knows where they can connect.

In src/components/canvas/CanvasView.tsx: Improve node rendering in CanvasNodeView. Add a proper header/title bar area to each card with a drag handle icon. Show the node type icon (text icon for text cards, file icon for note cards). Add a subtle shadow and better border styling that matches Obsidian's cards. When a node has a color, make the entire card have a tinted background rather than just a thin strip at the top.

In src/components/canvas/CanvasView.tsx: Add resize from ALL edges and corners (not just bottom-right). Add 8 resize handles: 4 corners + 4 edges. Each handle should have appropriate cursor styling (nwse-resize, nesw-resize, ew-resize, ns-resize). The resize logic should update x/y position for top/left handles to keep the opposite corner fixed.

In src/components/canvas/CanvasView.tsx: Add a minimap in the bottom-left corner showing an overview of all nodes as tiny dots/rectangles on the canvas, with a viewport rectangle showing the currently visible area. Clicking on the minimap should jump the viewport to that position. This matches Obsidian's canvas minimap feature.

In src/lib/canvas/canvas-model.ts: Add a 'group' or 'frame' node type to the CanvasNodeType. Add support for grouping selected nodes into a frame (container node that moves all its children together). This is a core Obsidian canvas feature.

In src/components/canvas/CanvasView.tsx: Add double-click on a node to enter edit mode (already exists). Add Enter key to confirm editing (in addition to Ctrl+Enter). Add Escape to cancel editing and revert to original text. Add right-click context menu on nodes with options: Delete, Duplicate, Change Color, Connect to...
Verify: run bunx --bun tsc --noEmit and bun run lint to confirm no errors.
acceptance_criteria: Edge connection ports are visible on node hover (not just on selection)
Nodes can be resized from any corner or edge
Canvas has a working minimap showing all nodes and the viewport area
Double-click on empty canvas creates a new node at that position
bunx --bun tsc --noEmit produces no new errors in src/
bun run lint passes with 0 errors
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/OpenVault && bunx --bun tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v examples/
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Edge connection handles now render outside the selected block and are visible on any hovered node. Multi-directional resize implemented with 8 handles (4 corners + 4 edges) using dx/dy position offsets for top/left handles to keep the opposite edge fixed. Minimap renders in bottom-left corner showing proportional node rectangles and viewport rectangle with click-to-navigate. Node styling improved with type icons (Type/FileText), color-mix background tinting, rounded-lg borders, and better shadows. zoomToFit wired to Maximize button (replaced resetView). TypeScript check only reports pre-existing errors in examples/ dir. ESLint passes with 0 errors.
